name: chatty-buddy-build-tooling
description: Local build tooling for Chatty Buddy. Compiles the self-hosted Tailwind stylesheet so the app no longer needs the runtime Tailwind CDN. Run 'npm install' once, then 'npm run build:css' whenever the markup or theme changes. Only the COMPILED output in ../public/assets/css ships to the running app; node_modules stays local.
